in_english.name: Khuloodun
in_english.meaning: Eternal life or permanent residence in Paradise
in_english.long_meaning: Khuloodun is a feminine given name of Arabic origin. It is derived from the Arabic root 'khalada,' which means 'to remain' or 'to abide.' Khuloodun reflects the hope for an everlasting life in a blissful afterlife.
